feature_contract.category_input: EXIF-corrected unsegmented original frame, transparency composited on white, RGB, then the pinned FashionCLIP processor (resize and center crop). Second-Hand source photos had already undergone upstream processing.
feature_contract.public_embedding: The separate historical BiRefNet display-crop vector, not the category vector.

sources.name: Clothing Dataset for Second-Hand Fashion
sources.creator: Farrukh Nauman (RISE Research Institutes of Sweden AB)
collection_partners: RISE Research Institutes of Sweden AB
sources.derivative_changes: Background removal, cleaning and resize to 224x224 as documented by the upstream dataset card.
sources.local_changes: Selected front-view items, filtered ambiguous/duplicate rows, remapped metadata labels to four project labels, built item-group splits and trained a FashionCLIP head; shards not modified or redistributed.

limitations: The 200-image new holdout is balanced and from the same Second-Hand source, with 50 frontal samples per class. Seed 0: accuracy 89.50%, macro-F1 89.55%. Neither this nor the four diagnostic photos establishes production performance.
No confidence calibration. One representative garment is assumed; backgrounds, people, multiple garments and processor center-cropping can affect results.
Label and upstream photo-processing bias remain. Exact/perceptual hash audits cannot exclude semantic duplicates or overlap with encoder pretraining.

Keep this manifest alongside any authorized handoff and verify its SHA-256. Use only trusted local checkpoints and pinned, reviewed model caches.
